candidates.title_ru: Кения: ИИ-советник не улучшил средний результат малого бизнеса
candidates.title_en: Kenya: AI advice did not improve average small-business performance
candidates.summary_ru: Рандомизированный эксперимент с 640 предпринимателями не выявил значимого среднего эффекта на выручку и прибыль. У исходно менее успешных участников результат ухудшился; выигрыш более успешных был лишь предположительным.
candidates.summary_en: A randomized trial with 640 entrepreneurs found no significant average revenue-and-profit effect. Initially lower-performing businesses did worse; gains among higher performers were only suggestive.
candidates.caveat_ru: Доступ к совету не гарантирует полезного применения. Самоотчёты, одна страна и короткий горизонт; положительный эффект сильной подгруппы не значим на уровне 5%.
candidates.caveat_en: Access to advice does not ensure beneficial implementation. Outcomes are self-reported, in one country over a short horizon; the higher-performing subgroup's positive estimate is not significant at 5%.

evidence_stage.causal_scope: Assignment to GPT-4 business advice via WhatsApp versus business guides; subgroup effects within this sample, not national inequality.
evidence_stage.headline_outcome: Business performance index, not employee wages or headcount.

candidates.title_ru: Фриланс: спрос на задания по текстам и коду снизился относительно контрольных категорий
candidates.title_en: Freelancing: writing and coding demand fell relative to comparison categories
candidates.summary_ru: Анализ 1,388,711 объявлений оценивает относительное снижение числа автоматизируемых заданий примерно на 21%. Оставшиеся задания стали сложнее и предлагали более высокую оплату.
candidates.summary_en: An analysis of 1,388,711 postings estimates an approximately 21% relative decline in automation-prone work. Remaining jobs were more complex and offered higher pay.
candidates.caveat_ru: Это объявления одной платформы, не число увольнений или заработки работников. Нерандомизированный DiD зависит от сопоставимости трендов; предложенная оплата не равна полученной зарплате.
candidates.caveat_en: These are postings on one platform, not layoffs or worker earnings. Nonrandomized DiD relies on comparable trends; offered pay is not realized wages.

evidence_stage.causal_scope: Differential changes after tool releases across task clusters, with synthetic and doubly robust DiD checks; not randomized adoption.
evidence_stage.headline_outcome: Posting demand relative to lower-exposure, manual-intensive comparison categories.
evidence_stage.internal_counterevidence: Higher offered pay among surviving postings means fewer postings cannot be translated mechanically into a uniform wage decline.

candidates.title_en: Three firms: Copilot increased task completion, especially for less-experienced developers
candidates.summary_ru: В трёх рандомизированных внедрениях с 4,867 разработчиками объединённая IV-оценка даёт рост выполненных задач на 26.08% (SE 10.3%). Менее опытные сотрудники чаще использовали инструмент и больше выигрывали.
candidates.summary_en: Across three randomized rollouts covering 4,867 developers, the pooled IV estimate is 26.08% more completed tasks (SE 10.3%). Less-experienced employees adopted more and gained more.
candidates.caveat_ru: Оценка использования инструмента не равна эффекту назначения доступа для всех. Испытания неоднородны и зарегистрированы постфактум; выпуск задач не доказывает рост зарплат, качества или сокращение штата.
candidates.caveat_en: The tool-use estimate is not the access-assignment effect for everyone. Trials are heterogeneous and postregistered; task output does not establish wage gains, quality gains or staffing reductions.

evidence_stage.causal_scope: Random assignment instruments actual use; pooled treatment-on-the-treated estimate at Microsoft, Accenture and an anonymous Fortune 100 firm.
evidence_stage.headline_outcome: Completed development tasks, operationalized through pull-request activity; not economy-wide productivity.
evidence_stage.disclosure: Vendor-affiliated coauthors and company-run experiments; inspect alongside independent evidence.

editorial_guardrails: Do not equate task throughput, time saved, job postings, actual hires, employment stocks, earnings and business profits.
Keep assignment effects separate from IV estimates of tool use, and causal designs separate from observational comparisons.
Do not count manuscripts, journal articles, institutional summaries and updates from one family as independent replications.
A null average can coexist with harmful and beneficial subgroups; a nonsignificant positive estimate is not a demonstrated gain.
No selected candidate establishes economy-wide job destruction, universal wage gains or a single distributional direction.
